readmeHtml:
chele.bi

Personal blog and portfolio of Ege Chelebi (@woosal1337).

A dark, editorial personal site — writing, projects, and a reading shelf — built with Next.js 14 (App Router), MDX, Tailwind CSS, and Biome, deployed on Vercel.

Highlights

  • Editorial dark theme: Geist Sans for reading, Geist Mono for code, hairline borders, one motion curve.
  • MDX blog with a left-rail table of contents, callouts, and per-post chrome.
  • Post banners generated from the title — a deterministic contour mark (lib/contour.ts), no manual cover images.
  • Liquid-glass circular controls and frosted-glass tags.
  • A single contour identity mark drives the logo and favicons.

Stack

  • Next.js 14 (App Router), React 18, TypeScript
  • MDX posts colocated under app/(website)/blog/(post)/[slug]/page.mdx
  • Tailwind CSS with a token layer in app/globals.css (dark, editorial)
  • Reusable design-system primitives in components/ds/, domain blocks in components/blocks/
  • Biome for linting and formatting

Local setup

bun install
bun dev

Requires Node >= 20 and Bun. No environment variables required.

Commands

  • bun dev — dev server
  • bun run build — production build
  • bun run check — Biome lint and format with auto-fix

Credits

The live ASCII surfaces in components/blocks/ascii/ — donut, flow, plasma, tunnel — are ported from cobanov/soft-club-ui (MIT) and retuned monochrome against this site's tokens. The table-of-contents marker geometry follows ncdai's LineNav.

License

Code is MIT. Blog content and images are all rights reserved. See LICENSE.

aiSummary.oneLiner: A dark, editorial personal blog and portfolio template built with Next.js 14 and MDX.
aiSummary.whatItDoes: chele.bi is a personal blog and portfolio codebase featuring a highly polished, editorial dark theme. It utilizes Next.js 14 App Router, MDX for content authoring, and Tailwind CSS for styling. The site includes unique design elements like algorithmically generated post banners based on deterministic contour marks, avoiding manual cover images. It serves as a comprehensive template for developers looking to build a sophisticated, content-focused personal website.
keyFeatures: Editorial dark theme: Features a refined aesthetic using Geist fonts, hairline borders, and a unified motion curve.
MDX integration: Supports rich blog posts with a left-rail table of contents, callouts, and customized per-post layouts.
Algorithmic banners: Generates deterministic contour marks for post headers directly from titles, eliminating manual image creation.
Interactive components: Includes liquid-glass circular controls, frosted-glass tags, and live ASCII aesthetic surfaces.
Modern stack: Built on Next.js 14 App Router, React 18, and styled with Tailwind CSS.
